issue.title: [Enhancement][Snappi] Documentation for pfcwd_a2a test case and dynamic port selection

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the enhancement

Documentation needs to be updated for testcase: tests/snappi_tests/pfcwd/test_pfcwd_a2a_with_snappi.py.

```
PFCWD a2a testcase involves having three IXIA ports connected to the DUT.
Let the ports be port A, port B and Port C.
Under all-to-all configuration, every IXIA port is sending traffic to every other port.
Port A is sending traffic to Port B and C. Port B is sending traffic to port A and C.
Port C is sending traffic to Port A and B.
One of the ports, let's say Port C is receiving PFC storm for the duration of the test.
Traffic going in and out of Port C sees loss due to PFC storm.
Traffic between Port A and B should NOT be affected due to storm on Port C,
hence no loss.
```

Documentation needs to be created for support for dynamic port selection and also way to choose between dynamic and static port selection.

@auspham , @sdszhang , @rawal01 , @vmittal-msft

### Current Behavior

Currently there is not enough documentation for both.

### Proposed Behavior

Update the documentation for the test case and create a new README for dynamic vs static port selection process.
